summary: Awareness of model pluralism, bias, and environmental impact is promoted through a conversational AI arena where users can explore and compare over 30 different models. The platform is used to teach people about model diversity, bias, sovereignty, and the energy cost of generative AI. It helps rank models on real use instead of English-first benchmarks, allowing users to see which ones work best in their own language or sector. The platform is built to be run by anyone, including companies, sectors, or language communities. It aims to collect preference data needed to narrow the gap in model performance outside English. The project's datasets and leaderboard are open to the public, allowing anyone to reuse them to study how people use these tools or to train and align models.
